desc: Hinged solid-steel floorplate features an engraved FTW logo. Natural Gear Camo Laminate Stock. LC6 trigger for smooth, crisp trigger pull. Non-rotating, Mauser-type controlled-feed extractor. Fixed blade-type ejector. New red rubber recoil pad. Hinged steel floor plate, with Ruger logo. Patented integral scope rings that attach directly to the precision machined receiver. Easily accessible three-position safety. Also includes: rugged one-piece, stainless steel bolt; studs for mounting sling swivels.
